ART STYLE: Lush, luminous digital painting in the spirit of a premium early-2000s Japanese RPG remastered in HD. Semi-realistic, anime-influenced characters with expressive faces and stylish asymmetrical adventure outfits: layered belts, buckles, straps, zippers, one-sleeved jackets, flowing scarves. Sun-drenched tropical environments painted in rich detail: saturated turquoise seas, white sand, emerald jungle, and ancient sandstone ruins carved with softly glowing glyphs. Golden-hour sunlight, with bioluminescent blue-green motes of light drifting through the air. Cinematic, epic and adventurous, with a mischievous sense of humor: witty, characterful expressions and small comedic details hidden in the scene. Mature and cool, never babyish or chibi.

This is a background painting for a 2D game: no characters or creatures unless the prompt asks for them, no user interface. Rich depth, clear foreground, midground and background.

Edit target: Image 1 is the existing 1536x1024 island map. Keep the whole painting identical, every landmark, coastline, ocean, volcano, crystal canyon, cove, temple, monkey head, distant ship and lighthouse unchanged. Make ONLY these small harbor additions within x=570..990, y=175..350: on the harbor's western sandy shore near (635,300), add a small BEACHED wooden ship converted to a menagerie, its hull visibly resting on dry white sand, with an open hold entrance and a short broad gangplank joining the harbor boardwalk. On the eastern harbor water near (920,310), add a clear rectangular wooden dueling platform on pilings, with an empty flat deck and two crossed practice swords on a small rack (no text); a continuous wooden walkway joins it to the existing town boardwalk near (850,265). These are small map landmarks at the same scale as the existing piers, never giant foreground objects. Keep the harbor arrival at (790,255) accessible. Preserve and clarify the narrow WALKABLE path from the town behind the central rooftops up the rocks to the existing lighthouse door at (814,170); do not alter the lighthouse. All three destinations must be connected via boardwalk, sand, or stone steps, never a route swimming across water. Add no people or creatures. Images 2 and 3 are painting style references only; do not reproduce any characters. Image 4 is the layout guide only: keep the new destinations outside the button corners. The attached guide image is a construction drawing: use it only for layout (where the floor, horizon, characters or cells are). Do not reproduce any of its lines, colors, shapes, labels or text. Opaque 1536x1024 landscape. Localized inpainting, not a redesign: copy every pixel outside the small harbor additions exactly.

Rules: completely original designs; never imitate an existing franchise, character, creature, logo or emblem. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermarks, signatures, borders or user interface, unless the prompt asks for glowing magic runes. Fierce and intense is great; no blood, gore or wounds. Every character is dressed for an all-ages game: modest clothing, no bare midriffs, no low necklines or cleavage, no revealing or tight-fitting costumes, and nothing sexualized in pose or proportion.
